documents.t: AISiteVolt doesn't just generate content — it repairs it. It fixes your old posts for Google, makes your articles quotable by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini (GEO), repairs thin WooCommerce product pages, and scores your content against accessibility standards — all inside your WordPress dashboard, with your own OpenAI API key. No monthly content fees, no data through our servers. 🚀 InstallationInstall the free plugin from WordPress.org in two minutes.🔑 API keysConnect your own OpenAI key — the only setup you need.🖥️ Run it locallyUse Ollama or LM Studio on your own machine — no key, no cost, nothing leaves your server.✍️ First articleGenerate, review and publish your first AI-assisted post.🔧 Content RepairLet AI fix grammar, SEO, readability and stale facts in existing posts.🤖 AI Visibility (GEO)Score and repair every post for AI-search citability.📊 Health ReportA printable GEO + accessibility report — free and unlimited.🛒 WooCommerce AIFind and rewrite thin product content in bulk.⭐ AISiteVolt ProAutopilots, chatbot, automations, white-label reports and more.

Everything you need to publish AI-assisted content, with no usage caps: Tool What it does Content Generator SEO-friendly blog posts with any OpenAI model AI Image Generator Featured images with GPT Image Content Repair Fix grammar, SEO, readability and outdated info in existing posts Quick AI Edit Rewrite, expand or translate selected text right in the editor Bulk Content Turn a topic list into queued drafts with SEO metadata AI Visibility analyzer GEO score for every post + an AI-visibility column in the posts list llms.txt generator Introduce your site to AI crawlers in one click WooCommerce scanner Find products with thin descriptions and missing SEO meta Image alt text scanner Find media images with no alt text Accessibility scanner WCAG / EAA content findings with per-post scores Health Report Printable website health report (GEO + accessibility)

AISiteVolt Pro turns the toolkit into a system that works for you: autopilots repair your weakest posts, products and accessibility issues on a schedule; an AI chatbot answers visitors from your own Knowledge Base and captures leads; Automations create and refresh content from topic lists, RSS and URLs; white-label reports let agencies send branded PDF health reports to clients; plus 7 more AI providers (Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Stability, Replicate, Leonardo). Every Pro purchase starts with a 7-day free trial. Your data stays yours AISiteVolt is a bring-your-own-key plugin. Prompts go directly from your server to your AI provider. Nothing passes through AISiteVolt servers — see External services & privacy.

The European Accessibility Act (EAA) and WCAG 2.1 expect your content to be usable by everyone. AISiteVolt scores each post and page against the most common content-level problems — and Pro repairs the fixable ones with AI.
documents.s: Accessibility Repair FREE scanner PRO repair

documents.t: Go to AISiteVolt → Accessibility Repair. Click Scan Posts & Pages. Each item gets a 0–100 score with its findings: Finding WCAG criterion Images missing alt text 1.1.1 Non-text Content Unhelpful alt text ("image", "photo") 1.1.1 Vague link text ("click here", "read more") 2.4.4 Link Purpose Empty links or buttons 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value Skipped heading levels (H2 → H4) 1.3.1 Info and Relationships More than one H1 1.3.1 Tables without header cells 1.3.1 If your site has no document language set, a one-click fix sets the WordPress site language option (changeable any time under Settings → General).

One click per post: the AI writes descriptive alt text, rewrites vague links so their destination is clear, fixes heading order, demotes extra H1s and adds table headers — then rescores. Typical result: a 56 becomes a 100.

Enable the autopilot to keep content accessible continuously: choose daily/weekly, posts per run and a score threshold — the least accessible posts are repaired automatically and the activity is logged on the page. Scope honestly This is an automated content review — color contrast, keyboard navigation, focus states, forms and third-party widgets still need manual testing. The Pro EAA report states this out-of-scope list explicitly, so client expectations stay correct.
Content Repair is the heart of the plugin: instead of only writing new posts, it fixes the ones you already have — usually your fastest SEO win.

AISiteVolt → Content Repair works on any published post or page: Pick posts — load your content list and select what to repair. Choose repair modes — grammar & spelling, readability, SEO optimization, structure, engagement. Analyze — the AI reads the post and proposes concrete changes with a before/after view. Apply — accepted suggestions are written back to the post. Tags, categories, excerpt, meta description and slug can be updated too. Optional extras per repair: Featured image generation. Convert to audio — narrate the post with OpenAI text-to-speech (voice, speed and player position are configurable; the player is embedded in the post and announced with AudioObject schema).
The Freshness tab finds stale content: old dates, superseded facts, "last updated" gaps. Run the quick scan (no AI cost) or the AI scan for deeper judgment, then send flagged posts through repair.

Open any post in the editor and scroll below the content: the Full Page Optimization panel repairs the post in place (works in both Classic and Gutenberg). Choose a repair mode, click repair, and the editor content updates — no copy-paste.

Give the panel a source URL and AISiteVolt fetches that page (from your server) and uses it as reference material while repairing — handy when repairing against documentation or a canonical source you trust. At scale (Pro) Pro repairs content hands-free: the AI Visibility autopilot fixes your weakest posts on a schedule and Automations refreshes old content on rotation.
documents.s: Page Repair with a source URL

documents.t: AISiteVolt → Bulk Content produces a whole content calendar in one sitting: paste topics, get drafts.

Add topics, one per line. Optionally append a focus keyword after a pipe: How to start a balcony garden | balcony garden Best budget standing desks 10 breakfast ideas for busy mornings Choose Save as: Draft (recommended) or Published. Keep Generate SEO metadata on to get a meta description, focus keyword and tags per post. Click Start Batch. A cost estimate is shown first — confirm to proceed. Watch the queue: each row shows status, cost and an Edit link when done. There is no cap on batch size in the free plugin — the whole list runs.

Pro replaces the plain list with a real editorial pipeline. Upload a CSV with columns: Column Purpose topic Required — the article subject keyword Focus keyword category_id Assign a category author_login Attribute to a specific author (requires editor rights) post_type e.g. post or page schedule_date YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM — posts are scheduled, not just drafted Rows honor WordPress permissions: assigning other authors needs edit_others_posts, scheduling needs publish_posts. Review before publishing Generate to Draft and skim each post. Ten minutes of human editing per post is the difference between content that ranks and content that reads generated.
AISiteVolt → Content Generator writes complete articles from a topic: title, structured headings, body copy and (optionally) SEO metadata.

Enter a topic — the more specific, the better the article. Pick a content type: blog post, article, product description, social copy or email. Choose tone (professional, casual, friendly, formal) and language. Choose the provider/model for this run. Free includes every OpenAI text model; Pro adds Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter (hundreds of models) and DeepSeek to the same dropdown. Optional switches: Generate SEO metadata — meta description, focus keyword and tags, written into Yoast or Rank Math. Generate featured image — creates and attaches an image in the same run. Click Generate Content, review the draft, then Create Post (saved as a draft).
Each run reports tokens and estimated cost. Everything is logged to AISiteVolt → History with the prompt, result, model and cost, so you can reuse or audit past generations.

Include the audience in the topic: "…explained for first-time gardeners". State the angle: comparison, checklist, how-to, opinion. Use Comprehensive length for pillar pages, Short for news-style updates. Always add your own experience before publishing — that's what ranks in 2026. Grounded generation (Pro) With the Pro Knowledge Base, generation is grounded in your own reference content — your terminology, your facts, your brand voice.

AISiteVolt → Health Report compiles your site's GEO readiness and accessibility findings into a clean, printable report — perfect for stakeholders, clients or your own quarterly review. It's computed entirely on your site, unlimited, with no AI cost.

Go to AISiteVolt → Health Report. Optionally enter Prepared for (a client or project name printed on the report). Pick the sections: GEO / AI visibility and Accessibility (EAA / WCAG). Click Generate report — it opens in a new tab inside your dashboard. Click Print / Save as PDF. The print view hides the WordPress admin — only the report prints.

GEO section — site average score, pages analysed, strongest pages and biggest opportunities (run an AI Visibility scan first to populate scores). Accessibility section — average score, issue breakdown (missing alt text, vague links, heading order, header-less tables) and the pages needing the most attention.

AISiteVolt Pro turns the Health Report into an agency deliverable: White-label branding — your agency name, logo, accent color and footer; no plugin branding anywhere on the printed sheet. EAA deep-dive template — findings mapped to WCAG 2.1 success criteria with a remediation plan and per-page details. AI activity section — what the AI repaired in the period (with optional spend, off by default for client copies). 28-day GEO trend — proof the work is paying off. Agency workflow Generate the free report for yourself today; when a client asks "can you send that to me with your logo on it?", that's your Pro trial moment.

documents.t: AISiteVolt → Image Generator turns a text prompt into ready-to-use images and saves them straight into your media library.

Describe the image. Concrete beats abstract: "top-down photo of a wooden desk with a laptop, coffee and a notebook, soft morning light". Pick a model — GPT Image variants in free; Pro adds Stable Diffusion 4 Ultra, Flux 2 (Max/Pro/Flex), Leonardo Phoenix and Gemini image models to the same screen. Choose size, style (realistic, digital art, illustration, minimalist, artistic) and count (1–6). Optional: upload a reference image to guide the composition (uses OpenAI's image-edit endpoint). Click Generate Image, then Save to Media Library on the results you like.
The Set as Default panel stores your house style — artist direction, lighting, camera, composition, resolution, color notes — and applies it to every future prompt so your images stay on-brand.

As featured images from the Content Generator's featured-image switch. Pro Automations can attach AI images — or royalty-free stock photos (Pexels/Pixabay with your own free keys) — to scheduled posts automatically. Alt text matters After inserting images, run the Image Alt Text Scanner — images without alt text hurt accessibility and image SEO.
Quick AI Edit lives inside the editor — no separate screen.

Open any post or page in the editor (Gutenberg or Classic). Select the text you want to change. Click the floating AI toolbar that appears near the selection. Pick an action: Improve — clearer, tighter wording Shorten / Expand Simplify — plainer language Fix grammar Change tone Translate Preview the result, then Apply to replace the selection or Reject to keep the original. The edit happens inline — your cursor position, formatting and the rest of the post are untouched.

Tightening intros and conclusions. Translating a quote or a paragraph without leaving the editor. Turning bullet notes into flowing prose (Expand). De-jargoning technical sections (Simplify) for a broader audience. tip Quick AI Edit uses your default provider/model from Settings. Short selections cost fractions of a cent.

AISiteVolt is a bring-your-own-key (BYOK) plugin: every AI call goes directly from your server to the provider, billed to your own account. The free plugin works with OpenAI; Pro adds seven more providers. No key at all? AISiteVolt can also use a model running on your own machine — see Run AI locally. No key, no bill, nothing leaves your server.

Sign in (or sign up) at platform.openai.com. Open API keys and click Create new secret key. Copy the key — it starts with sk- and is shown only once. Add a small amount of credit under Billing (a few dollars goes a long way: a full blog post typically costs a few cents).
documents.s: Step 1 — Create an OpenAI API key

documents.t: In WordPress, go to AISiteVolt → Settings → API Keys. Paste the key into the OpenAI API Key field. Click Save Settings. Saved keys are stored in your WordPress database and displayed masked (********) afterwards — leaving the field masked and saving again keeps the stored key.
documents.s: Step 2 — Add the key to AISiteVolt

documents.t: Click Test OpenAI Connection under the key field. You should see "Connection successful!". If not, see Troubleshooting.

On the Models tab you can pick the default text model (GPT-4o, GPT-4o Mini, the GPT-5.x family…) and the image model (GPT Image). OpenAI models are never restricted in the free plugin — new models appear in the dropdowns as we ship updates. Most tools also let you override the model per run.

Every generation shows its token usage and estimated cost; the Dashboard and Settings → Advanced show totals per user and site-wide (30 days). Batch actions (Bulk Content, Repair All, autopilots) show a cost estimate confirmation before spending. Pro adds hard monthly spend/token limits, including per-role limits. Keep keys private Never paste API keys into support emails or public forums. If a key leaks, revoke it in the provider dashboard and create a new one — then update it in Settings.
This walkthrough takes you from an empty site to a published, SEO-ready post in about five minutes. It assumes you've installed the plugin and connected an OpenAI key.
Go to AISiteVolt → Content Generator.

Topic — be specific: "How often should you water basil, including signs of overwatering" beats "basil care". Choose a content type (blog post, article, product description…), tone and language. Pick the model — GPT-4o is a great default; GPT-4o Mini is cheaper for drafts. Optionally tick Generate SEO metadata so a meta description, focus keyword and tags are produced with the article (written straight into Yoast SEO or Rank Math if installed — see SEO integrations).
Click Generate Content. In 10–30 seconds the article appears with its token usage and cost. Read it — AI output is a draft, not a final say. Regenerate or tweak the topic if the angle is wrong.
Click Create Post: the article is saved as a draft post, with SEO metadata attached. Open it in the editor to polish headings, add internal links and your own perspective.
Either use the AI Image Generator and insert the result from your media library, or tick the featured-image option during generation if you enabled it in Settings.
Hit Publish in the editor. Done — your first AI-assisted article is live.

Fix your existing posts with Content Repair — that's where AISiteVolt really differs from generator-only plugins. Score the new post for AI-search citability with AI Visibility. Producing at scale? Bulk Content turns a topic list into a queue of drafts.
AISiteVolt installs like any WordPress plugin and takes about two minutes.
Requirement Minimum WordPress 5.8 or newer PHP 7.4 or newer An OpenAI account Free to create — you pay OpenAI only for what you use WooCommerce (optional) Only for the store tools
In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New Plugin. Search for "AISiteVolt". Click Install Now, then Activate. A new AISiteVolt menu appears in your admin sidebar.
Download the plugin ZIP from WordPress.org. Go to Plugins → Add New Plugin → Upload Plugin. Choose the ZIP file, click Install Now, then Activate.

Click AISiteVolt in the admin sidebar — the Dashboard opens with usage stats (all zeros for now) and shortcuts to every tool. Continue to Connect your API key — nothing generates until a key is saved. Free vs Pro are the same plugin slug The free plugin comes from WordPress.org. If you later upgrade to Pro, the Professional build is delivered through Freemius as an in-place upgrade — same menu, same settings, no double installation and nothing to migrate.
Updates arrive through the normal WordPress Plugins screen. Your settings, API keys and history are preserved across updates.

Deactivating keeps all data. Deleting the plugin from the Plugins screen removes everything it created: its database tables, options, scheduled tasks and post meta. Your posts, products and their content are never touched.

AISiteVolt can talk to a model running on your own machine instead of a cloud provider. There is no API key to buy, no per-word cost, and no prompt or article ever leaves your server. This is in the free plugin — nothing here needs Pro. When this is the right choice Building a site locally, working with client material you'd rather not send to a third party, generating a lot of draft content, or simply not wanting a metered bill while you experiment.

Any server that speaks the OpenAI chat API. The common ones: Tool Default address Notes Ollama http://localhost:11434 Easiest starting point on Mac, Windows and Linux LM Studio http://localhost:1234 Desktop app with a model browser; enable the local server vLLM http://localhost:8000 For serious hardware and concurrent requests LiteLLM varies A gateway in front of many providers at once

With Ollama, one command pulls a model: ollama pull llama3.2 Small models (3B–8B) are fast on ordinary laptops and perfectly capable of outlines, product copy, FAQ sections and rewrites. Larger models (14B and up) write noticeably better long-form articles but need more memory. Check it is running: curl http://localhost:11434/v1/models

In WordPress, go to AISiteVolt → Settings → API Keys. Find the Local AI server section. Server URL — http://localhost:11434 (the /v1 part is added for you). Model name — exactly as your server names it, e.g. llama3.2:latest. API key — leave empty. Local servers don't use one. Click Test local server. A successful test reports the models the server actually has installed, for example: Connected. 3 model(s) available: llama3.2:latest, qwen2.5:14b, mistral-nemo:12b. Then click Save Settings.

Open AISiteVolt → Content Generator and pick Local AI server in the provider list. The model dropdown fills itself from your server, so pulling a new model in Ollama makes it selectable here without touching the plugin. Generate as usual. The entry in AISiteVolt → History will show a cost of 0 — because there was nothing to bill.

This pairs well with local development. A typical agency workflow: Spin the site up locally (for example in Studio, the free local WordPress app). Run Ollama on the same machine. Use Bulk Content to turn a topic list into drafts, and Content Repair to tighten what's already there — all offline, at no cost, with the client's material never leaving your laptop. Switch the provider to OpenAI later if you want a stronger model for the pieces that matter most. Moving a local site to production Images generated locally are stored with a local URL such as http://localhost:8881/wp-content/uploads/.... That is normal for any local WordPress site — remember to run a proper search-replace for the site URL when you migrate, or the images will break. Migration tools do this for you.

Works Doesn't Content Generator, Bulk Content, Content Repair, GEO rewrites, product copy — anything text Image generation — use OpenAI for that Any model your server exposes Audio transcription and speech Text is where local models shine. Image models are a different kind of server and AISiteVolt keeps image generation on the providers that support it.
documents.s: What local models can and can't do here

documents.t: "No local model name is configured yet." The model field is empty, or the name doesn't match. Run ollama list and copy the name exactly, tag included. "The server did not return a model list." The server isn't reachable at that address. Check it is running, and that the port matches. Connection works but generation is slow. Small models are far quicker; a 3B model on a laptop answers in seconds, a 30B model may take minutes. Model size, not the plugin, is the bottleneck. Running Ollama on another machine. Use its LAN address (for example http://192.168.1.20:11434) and make sure Ollama listens on the network (OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0).
Connect your API keys — the cloud provider setup Write your first article Bulk Content — the fastest way to use a local model
AISiteVolt → Settings has four tabs. Saving is instant (AJAX) — you'll see a success notice without a page reload.

Provider keys, each with a Test Connection button. Free shows OpenAI; Pro adds Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Stability AI, Replicate, Leonardo and Reddit app credentials. Keys display masked after saving; an empty or masked field on save means keep the stored key.

Default model per task: OpenAI text model — used wherever you don't override per run. Image model — GPT Image variants in free; Pro adds Stable Diffusion, Flux, Leonardo and Gemini image models. Pro also exposes default models for Claude, Gemini and DeepSeek plus a free-typed OpenRouter model id.

Option Effect Default provider Which provider tools use unless overridden Default content length Short (~500 words) to Comprehensive (~2500) Auto-generate SEO Produce meta description, focus keyword and tags with each article Featured image by default Pre-check "Generate Featured Image" in the Content Generator Images per generation 1–6 images per Image Generator run Default image style Realistic, digital art, illustration, minimalist, artistic Max tokens / Temperature Response size limit and creativity dial Default language / tone Applied wherever you don't choose explicitly

Usage statistics — your totals plus site-wide 30-day cost and tokens. Clear history — wipes the generation history table. Pro adds: monthly spend/token limits, per-role limits, event webhooks, a Slack webhook, stock-photo API keys and Settings export/import. tip Defaults are just defaults — nearly every screen lets you pick provider, model and options per run.
AI Forms lets you publish interactive AI tools on your site: a visitor fills a short form, your AI answers inline — and interested visitors become leads.

Three ways, on AISiteVolt → AI Forms: Describe it — "a tool that estimates kitchen renovation cost from size and quality level" → the AI designs the fields and prompt for you (Prompt-to-Form). Start from a template — support helper, price estimator, content brief, product recommender, image analysis. Build manually — up to 12 fields (text, textarea, select, number, email, image, file) with a live preview. The prompt uses {field_slug} placeholders that get replaced with the visitor's answers. Image fields are actually seen by vision-capable models — perfect for "what plant is this?" or damage-assessment tools.
Shortcode: [autore82_form id=123] Or the AI Form Gutenberg block (pick the form from a dropdown).

Control Detail Per-form provider/model/temperature/max-tokens Match cost to the tool's value Separate guest and member quotas Per day/week/month, with a custom limit message Moderation word filter Blocks banned terms before any AI call Rate limit + honeypot + same-origin Bots can't burn your credits

If a submission contains an email address, it becomes a lead in Lead Management (with the answers attached). Optional Slack notification per submission, and a "Save as draft" handoff turns a great AI answer into a post draft for your editors. Forms can be duplicated, exported/imported as JSON, and usage is logged to History under the form owner. Ideas that convert Quote estimators for service businesses, sizing guides for stores, "analyze my X" tools for consultants — each one is a lead magnet that works while you sleep.
Three Pro tools that measure instead of write.

AISiteVolt → SEO Analyzer runs an AI audit on any post: Pick a post (and optionally a focus keyword). The AI evaluates title, structure, keyword usage, readability, meta and internal linking. You get a scored report with actionable recommendations — fix them by hand or send the post through Content Repair. Use it on your money pages first; a deduplicated issue list keeps the report tight.

Tracks what Reddit says about the terms you care about (your brand, your product category, competitors): Configure the terms and check frequency. AISiteVolt searches Reddit and keeps a history of mentions with links. Jump into relevant threads while they're still warm — authentic community answers beat ads. Add free Reddit app credentials for reliable results from server IPs.

The reality check for your GEO work: for a given post, the AI is asked the question your post answers — then the response is checked for whether your site is cited. You get the verdict (CITED / NOT CITED) plus the actual AI answer snippet, so you can see who is getting quoted and what they do differently.
Automations is your scheduled editorial staff. Define tasks once; a background queue executes them a few items at a time, every 15 minutes, with full visibility.

Task What it does Create content — topic list Works through your list of topics, producing drafts (or scheduled posts) Create content — RSS Watches feeds (with include/exclude keyword filters and duplicate protection) and writes original articles from new items Create content — page URLs Generates articles based on pages you point it at Create content — CSV Upload or paste CSV rows with keyword, category, author, post type and schedule date per row Optimize content Refreshes your existing posts on rotation (each post at most once per 30 days) Internal linking Fully automatic: AI picks anchor text in new content and links to your relevant posts (see Internal Linker) Comment replies Drafts AI replies to new comments, honoring your Comment Replier settings and a daily cap

Per task: provider/model, immediate or smart-spread scheduling (drip N hours apart), or dates from your CSV. Optional extras per task: AI featured image — or a royalty-free stock photo (Pexels/Pixabay, your own free keys) — plus SEO excerpt/tags/slug. The queue monitor shows pending/processing/completed/failed items with retry; tasks can be paused, resumed, run now, or deleted; an activity log tracks everything. Run now shows a cost-estimate confirmation before spending; per-tick limits and your monthly caps keep budgets safe.

Topic-list task, 2 posts/week, smart-spread, save as Draft. Optimize task on your top 20 evergreen posts. Internal-linking task so every new post links into your existing content. Review drafts every Monday — publish what's good. Webhooks Each completed automation item can fire a webhook to Zapier/Make/n8n — e.g. notify Slack or update a content calendar.

Autopilots are the "system, not a tool" part of Pro: small scheduled runs that keep your site repaired without you thinking about it. All of them respect your monthly spend limits and show a cost estimate when you enable them.

On AISiteVolt → AI Visibility: Enable the autopilot; choose daily / twice daily / weekly. Set posts per run (1–10) and the score threshold (fix posts scoring below it). Each run scans, picks the weakest posts, writes the direct answer + FAQ + schema, and logs the before → after scores on the page. Repaired posts are skipped for 30 days.
Tick "Email me a weekly GEO report" to get the site average, the five weakest posts (with edit links) and recent autopilot activity in your inbox every week.

On AISiteVolt → Accessibility Repair: same pattern — frequency, posts per run, threshold — repairing alt text, link text, heading order and table headers on your least accessible content. See Accessibility.
On AISiteVolt → WooCommerce AI: rewrites thin product copy daily or weekly, skipping healthy and recently repaired products. See WooCommerce AI.

Independent of the fixer, Pro records a daily snapshot of your site-wide GEO score (pure local math, no AI cost) and charts it on the AI Visibility page — with the 28-day delta surfacing in reports. Safety behaviors Every autopilot stops its run on a provider error instead of retrying into your bill, honors the site-wide and per-role limits, and logs its activity where you enabled it.
The Pro chatbot answers visitors from your own content, captures leads, opens support tickets, and lets a human take over the conversation in real time.

Go to AISiteVolt → AI Chatbot → Settings. Write the bot's role and rules (system prompt), pick the provider/model, set the welcome message and widget colors/position. Fill your Knowledge Base — the bot grounds every answer in it and refuses to invent prices, policies or shipping details it doesn't know. Enable the widget site-wide, or embed it inline on a page with the chat shortcode.

If a visitor types an email address, it's saved as a lead automatically (with the conversation attached) and you're notified. The "talk to a human" flow opens a support ticket with a reference number (e.g. TKT-20260803-6E1F3) and the full transcript; duplicate submissions are throttled. Everything lands in Lead Management.

When a visitor asks for a human, the conversation appears under AI Chatbot → Conversations → 🔴 Live conversations. Reply from your dashboard and the visitor sees your messages in the widget within seconds — a real-time human handoff without any external live-chat service.
Add your WhatsApp number in settings and the handoff panel shows a green "Continue on WhatsApp" button (the visitor initiates the chat — you never message first).

Daily budget — when the bot's daily AI spend cap is hit, visitors get your friendly offline message + the contact form instead of an AI answer, and you're emailed once. Rate limiting per IP, same-origin checks, honeypot — bots and abuse can't burn your credits. Off means off: disabling the chatbot removes the widget and its assets entirely from the site.
Conversations are stored on your site (and are covered by the plugin's GDPR export/erase integration). Visitor messages go to your AI provider only — see External services.
Five Pro tools turn other media into WordPress articles.

AISiteVolt → YouTube to Blog, paste one or more YouTube URLs (one per line). The transcript is fetched and rewritten into a structured article — not a raw transcript dump. Review and create the draft. Great for repurposing your own channel into search traffic.
Upload a podcast episode or recording (MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG). Whisper transcribes it, then the article is written from the transcript. Interviews become Q&A posts; solo episodes become how-tos.

Enter a topic or a subreddit: AISiteVolt pulls the top discussions and writes an article informed by what real people actually ask and argue about — excellent for pain-point content. Add free Reddit app credentials so it works reliably from server IPs.
Combine up to several sources — URLs, YouTube videos, Reddit threads, pasted text — into one coherent article with a title and focus you set. The strongest tool for roundups and comparison pieces.

Paste notes, import a Google Docs share link or any URL into the notebook; then ask the AI to process the material — summarize, outline, or draft a post from it — and publish the result. Think of it as a scratchpad with a writer attached. Attribution When your article leans on specific sources, cite and link them. The importers give you a draft grounded in the material — editorial judgment (and credit) stays with you.
Internal links are the cheapest SEO you're not doing. The Internal Linker finds the opportunities, writes the anchor and places the link — you just approve.

Go to AISiteVolt → Internal Linker. Select the posts to scan and the AI model, then click AI Scan for Links. Review the suggestions: each shows the source post, the proposed anchor text (real text already in the post) and the target post, with context. Apply the ones you like (or dismiss). The link is inserted exactly at the anchor — the post's wording doesn't change. Already-linked text is never double-linked.
Add an Internal linking task in Automations and new content gets linked into your existing posts hands-free — the AI picks the anchor and target on a schedule.

Every applied link — manual or automatic — is recorded in the Applied links archive at the bottom of the page: date, post, anchor and target (last 300). It's your audit trail for "what changed on the site", and clicking through makes spot-checking easy. Strategy Point links toward your money pages (services, cornerstone guides, key products). After a Bulk Content batch, run one scan across the new drafts so they weave into your site from day one.
The Knowledge Base (KB) is how you stop AI from guessing. Whatever you put here — delivery times, prices, policies, product facts, brand voice — grounds the chatbot and the content tools.

Go to AISiteVolt → Knowledge Base. Add entries as title + content ("Shipping times", "Barista Pro 900 specs", "Return policy"…). That's it — the chatbot and generators pull the most relevant entries into every request. Curated entries always win: they are your explicit facts.

Beyond manual entries, Pro can index your own posts and pages as reference material: Per post — in the editor, tick "AI Reference" in the AISiteVolt meta box; the post is chunked and embedded (OpenAI text-embedding-3-small) on save. In bulk — on the Knowledge Base page, select posts and click Index selected posts (with a cost preview; embeddings are very cheap). At question time, retrieval is hybrid: your curated KB entries first, then the most semantically relevant post chunks — with a relevance floor so an off-topic chunk never drowns out your explicit facts.
documents.s: Semantic grounding from your posts (hybrid RAG)

documents.t: Without KB: "I'm not sure about delivery times…" With KB: "Standard delivery is 2–4 business days; express orders placed before 14:00 ship same day." The same grounding feeds the Content Generator, so new articles use your terminology and never contradict your documented facts. What to index Index evergreen reference pages (services, policies, product guides) — not news posts. Re-index a post after major edits by saving it again with "AI Reference" ticked.
Everything your visitor-facing AI captures lands in AISiteVolt → Lead Management.

Captured automatically when a visitor shares an email with the chatbot or submits an AI Form containing an email. Each lead carries its source conversation or form answers, so you have context before you reply. Work the pipeline with statuses (New → Contacted → In Progress → Qualified → Converted/Closed), priorities and types; filter and search across all of it. Export to CSV streams the current list for your CRM (with spreadsheet-formula injection protection built in).

"Talk to a human" requests from the chatbot arrive as tickets with reference numbers and transcripts. Track them Open → Waiting → Resolved. Email notifications go to the address you configure (with a test email button to verify delivery).
Browse full chatbot conversations — including anonymous ones that never became leads — to see what visitors actually ask. That list is your next ten Knowledge Base entries.
AISiteVolt hooks into WordPress's Export Personal Data and Erase Personal Data tools: a visitor's leads and chat history are included in both flows.
The free plugin is a complete toolkit. Pro turns it into a system that works for you — repairing, publishing, answering and reporting on a schedule, while you keep full control of costs.

In WordPress, open AISiteVolt → Pro Features (or Upgrade). Start the 7-day free trial — no credit card required. The Professional build installs as an in-place upgrade (same menu, same settings). Cancel any time; your free plugin keeps working exactly as before. Pro is delivered and licensed through Freemius; one license can cover multiple sites depending on your plan.

Hands-free maintenance Autopilots — GEO fixer, accessibility repair, WooCommerce catalog rewriting and a weekly email report. Automations — scheduled content creation from topic lists, RSS or URLs; content refresh; automatic internal linking; comment replies. Visitor-facing AI AI Chatbot — grounded in your Knowledge Base, with lead capture, support tickets, live agent takeover and WhatsApp hand-off. AI Forms — no-code AI tools for visitors (estimators, support helpers, brief generators). AI Product Advisor — visitors describe a need, your AI recommends matching products. Agency deliverables White-label & EAA reports, the GEO trend chart, and settings export/import to roll your configuration across client sites. Content power tools Importers — YouTube-to-blog, audio-to-blog, Reddit research, Multi-Source, AI Notebook. Internal Linker, SEO Analyzer & Brand Monitor & Citation Check, Workflow Studio, Lead Management. Providers & governance 7 more AI providers: Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Stability AI, Replicate, Leonardo. Usage limits, webhooks and cost controls. Guideline-friendly by design The free plugin on WordPress.org is complete and uncapped — Pro features are separate additions, not unlocks. That's why upgrading never changes how your free tools behave.

The Product Advisor is a conversion tool for WooCommerce stores: instead of forcing visitors to guess your category tree, they describe what they need and the AI picks the best products from your catalog.

Place the shortcode on any page (a landing page, the shop sidebar area, a "help me choose" page): [autore82_product_advisor] That's the whole setup — it uses your default provider/model and your live catalog.

A single question: "What are you looking for?" with a text box. They type e.g. "a durable everyday backpack for a laptop and gym gear". Up to three product cards appear: image, title, price and a one-line reason why it fits — each linking to the product page. The AI chooses only from your real products (recent, in-catalog items are offered to it; invented products are impossible by design). Answers come back in the visitor's language.

Same-origin + honeypot + per-IP rate limiting (5/min) — the endpoint can't be farmed by bots. No visitor data is stored; the request text goes to your AI provider only. Usage is logged to History so the cost is visible; your monthly limits apply. Placement Put it where indecision happens: the empty-search result page, category pages with 50+ products, or a dedicated "Gift finder" landing page you can link in campaigns.

Free works with every OpenAI model. Pro adds seven providers — each with its own key field and Test Connection button under Settings → API Keys. Provider Best for Example models Anthropic Claude Long-form quality, nuanced tone Claude Sonnet, Opus, Haiku families Google Gemini Fast drafting, image generation Gemini Flash/Pro, Gemini image models OpenRouter One key, hundreds of models Any vendor/model id — Llama, Mistral, Qwen… DeepSeek Very low cost text DeepSeek V3 (chat), R1 (reasoner) Stability AI Photorealistic images SD 4 Ultra, SD 3.5 Replicate Flux image family FLUX 2 Max/Pro/Flex Leonardo Stylized/consistent characters Phoenix 2.0

Set a default provider and per-provider default models in Settings. Nearly every tool has a per-run picker (e.g. draft with DeepSeek, polish with Claude). Automations and AI Forms can pin a provider/model per task or per form. If a chosen provider has no key, tools fall back to your default provider instead of failing.

Reddit blocks anonymous requests from many hosts. For Reddit Research and Brand Monitor, create a free "script" app at reddit.com/prefs/apps and paste the client id/secret in Settings — read-only, no Reddit password involved. Cost strategy A common setup: DeepSeek or GPT-4o Mini for bulk drafting, Claude or GPT-4o for customer-facing copy, Stability/Flux for hero images. Your usage limits cap the total regardless of mix.
The free Health Report becomes an agency deliverable in Pro: branded, deeper, and ready to send to clients.

On AISiteVolt → White-label Report: Enter your agency name, logo URL (upload to the media library and paste its address), accent color and report footer (e.g. "Prepared by Acme Digital — hello@acme.agency"). Click Save branding. The printed report carries only your brand — no plugin branding anywhere on the sheet. Branding travels with settings export/import, so you configure it once and roll it to every client site.

Website health (standard) — the free report plus: AI repair & content activity for the chosen period (7/30/90 days), with an optional AI spend section (off by default — keep it off for client copies). The 28-day GEO score change card from the trend recorder. EAA accessibility deep-dive — a compliance-shaped report: Findings mapped to WCAG 2.1 success criteria (1.1.1, 1.3.1, 2.4.4, 4.1.2) with affected pages, instance counts and a plain-language remediation recommendation per finding. Site-level checks (document language, 3.1.1) with pass/fail. Per-page findings for every reviewed page. An explicit out-of-scope section (contrast, keyboard, forms, media, third-party widgets) and the statement that this is an automated content review, not a legal conformity assessment — so your deliverable never overpromises.

Pick the type, client name and period → Generate report → Print / Save as PDF (the print view contains only the branded sheet). Attach the PDF to your monthly client email — the GEO trend card does the "was it worth it?" conversation for you.
Pro treats your AI budget like production infrastructure: visible, capped, and portable.

Under Settings → Advanced: Limit Behavior Monthly spend limit ($) Site-wide 30-day cap. When reached, every AI action is blocked with a clear message until the window rolls. 0 disables. Monthly token limit Same, in tokens. Per-role limits (JSON) e.g. {"author":{"cost":5,"tokens":100000}} — authors can draft freely but can't outspend their allowance. Limits are enforced at the single point every tool passes through — nothing bypasses them, including autopilots and visitor-facing AI.

Batch triggers (Bulk Content, Repair All, Automations run-now, autopilot enabling) show a confirmation modal with the estimated cost before anything is spent — based on the item count and your current model's pricing.

Set a webhook URL (Zapier / Make / n8n compatible) and AISiteVolt POSTs JSON on: content_generated, form_submitted, automation_item_completed. Use it to notify Slack, append to a content-calendar sheet, or trigger downstream publishing steps. A separate Slack webhook field posts AI Form submissions directly to a channel.

Roll your configuration across sites (the agency workflow): Settings → Advanced → Export settings (JSON) downloads your configuration — models, defaults, limits, white-label branding, chatbot settings. On the next site: Import settings, pick the file, confirm. Security by design: API keys, Reddit credentials and webhook URLs are never exported and never overwritten by an import — each site keeps its own secrets. Invalid files are rejected with a clear message.
Workflow Studio chains AISiteVolt's capabilities into repeatable pipelines.

Go to AISiteVolt → Workflow Studio. Compose steps — e.g. research a topic → draft the article → generate a featured image → create the post. Save the workflow with a name; your saved workflows are listed for one-click re-runs. Execute — steps run in order, passing their output forward; the result can be published or saved as a draft for review. Workflows are yours: each user's saved workflows are scoped to their account.

Workflow Studio = on-demand, multi-step: "run my launch-article pipeline for this topic, now." Automations = scheduled, single-purpose: "two posts a week from this topic list, forever." They combine well: design the perfect sequence in Workflow Studio, then let Automations handle the recurring simple cases.

documents.t: The full, always-current changelog lives on the WordPress.org plugin page. Highlights:

Free Health Report — printable GEO + accessibility report, unlimited, PDF from the browser. Pre-run cost estimates on batch actions. Cleaner result tables (direct "Available in Pro" links), assets load only on plugin screens, hardened sanitization and uninstall cleanup, expanded External Services documentation. Pro White-label reports and the EAA deep-dive template (WCAG-mapped, with remediation plan). GEO trend — daily site score snapshots with a chart and 28-day delta. WooCommerce catalog autopilot and the AI Product Advisor storefront widget. Settings export/import (secrets never leave the site). Knowledge Base semantic grounding — AI-Reference posts + bulk indexing (hybrid retrieval). Applied links archive for the Internal Linker.
Pro: AI Forms image/file uploads with vision models; a new Image-analysis template. Pro: Automations stock-photo featured images (Pexels/Pixabay, your keys).
Pro: Accessibility Repair AI (free scanner + Pro one-click and autopilot repair). Pro: Live chat takeover — reply to chatbot visitors in real time from the dashboard.
Pro: Automations (topic/RSS/URL creation, refresh rotation, auto internal-linking, comment replies) and AI Forms. Pro: monthly usage limits, event webhooks, WhatsApp hand-off.
New design system across all screens, masked API keys, accessibility improvements.

Initial WordPress.org release line: content generation, image generation, Content Repair, Quick AI Edit, AI Visibility (GEO) + llms.txt, WooCommerce & alt-text scanners, Bulk Content, chatbot (Pro), importers (Pro), Workflow Studio (Pro), Lead Management (Pro), and the full security/GDPR baseline.

AISiteVolt is bring-your-own-key: AI requests go directly from your server to the provider you configured, on your own account. No content, prompt or key ever passes through AISiteVolt's servers. Nothing is sent anywhere without an explicit user action.

Endpoint When Data sent /v1/chat/completions You click Generate / Repair / Edit Your prompt and the content being processed /v1/images/generations Image generation Your image prompt /v1/images/edits Only when you supply a reference image Prompt + the reference image /v1/audio/speech Only when you enable "Convert to audio" in Content Repair The post title and content, for narration /v1/models Only when you click "Test Connection" Your API key (verification only) When you give Content Repair / Page Repair a source URL, your server fetches that page you typed — nothing else is sent in that step. OpenAI: privacy policy · terms

The upgrade/licensing infrastructure. Nothing is sent unless you opt in on the activation screen or start a checkout. If you opt in: site URL, WordPress/PHP/plugin versions and admin email — for updates and support. Skip opt-in and the free plugin works fully, sending nothing. Your content and API keys are never sent to Freemius. Privacy · Terms

Anthropic (api.anthropic.com), Google (generativelanguage.googleapis.com), OpenRouter (openrouter.ai), DeepSeek (api.deepseek.com), Stability (api.stability.ai), Replicate (api.replicate.com), Leonardo (cloud.leonardo.ai) — same pattern: your prompt/content to your chosen provider, on your key, only on explicit actions (or the schedules you enable). Reddit's public API is used read-only for Reddit Research / Brand Monitor. Pexels/Pixabay are contacted only if you add their keys for stock photos. Your own webhook/Slack URLs receive the JSON events you configure.

documents.t: Generation history, settings, leads/tickets/chat logs (Pro) — all in your WordPress database. Leads and chats are included in WordPress's GDPR export/erase tools. Deleting the plugin removes everything it created.
Yes. Every free feature is complete and uncapped. You pay only your AI provider (OpenAI) for the tokens you use. Pro is a separate set of additional modules, not an unlock.

documents.t: Typically a few cents with GPT-4o (less with GPT-4o Mini). Every run shows its exact token usage and estimated cost, and batch actions show an estimate before running.

documents.t: No. Prompts go directly from your server to your AI provider, billed to your own key. See External services.
documents.s: Does my content pass through AISiteVolt's servers?

documents.t: Every OpenAI text and image model — GPT-4o, the GPT-5.x family, GPT Image. OpenAI models are never restricted in the free plugin. Pro adds Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Stability, Replicate and Leonardo.

documents.t: Unedited, mass-published AI content can. AISiteVolt's philosophy is repair + review: ground generation in your facts, repair what exists, and always edit drafts. Google's guidance targets unhelpful content, not AI assistance per se.

documents.t: Generative Engine Optimization — being quotable by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini answers. A growing share of discovery happens there. Start with the AI Visibility scanner and llms.txt.

documents.t: Email support@aisitevolt.com, or use the WordPress.org support forum for the free plugin.

"Invalid API key or insufficient permissions" Re-copy the key from your provider dashboard (no leading/trailing spaces) and save again. OpenAI keys need available billing credit — check platform.openai.com → Billing. Project-scoped keys must have model access enabled for the models you selected. "Connection failed (HTTP …)" 429 = rate/credit limit at the provider; wait or add credit. 5xx = provider outage; check their status page. Timeouts on shared hosting: try again — long generations occasionally exceed strict host timeouts; shorter max-tokens helps.

"Please enter an API key first" — the tool's selected provider has no saved key; either add one or switch the run's provider to OpenAI. Empty or cut-off article — raise Max Tokens in Settings → Defaults; very long "Comprehensive" articles need 4000+. "AI returned an unexpected format" — rare model hiccup on structured tasks; clicking the action again almost always succeeds.

No AISiteVolt menu — the plugin is network-installed but not activated on this site, or your role lacks access (most screens need editor/admin capabilities). A button does nothing — check the browser console for a JavaScript conflict from another plugin; test with other plugins temporarily disabled. AISiteVolt loads its scripts only on its own screens, so conflicts are rare.

Bot answers "I'm not sure…" to things it should know — the fact isn't in your Knowledge Base; add a KB entry or index the relevant page as AI Reference. Visitors report "taking a short break" message — the chatbot's daily budget cap was reached (you were emailed once); raise the cap or wait for the daily rollover.

YouTube transcript unavailable — some videos have no transcript, and YouTube blocks transcript fetches from some datacenter IPs; try another video or add the content via the Notebook. Reddit results empty — add Reddit app credentials; anonymous Reddit access is blocked from many hosts.
Email support@aisitevolt.com with: your WordPress + PHP versions, the tool and exact action, and the error text. Screenshots help enormously.

People increasingly ask ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini instead of searching. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is about making your content quotable by those AI answers. AISiteVolt scores exactly that.

Go to AISiteVolt → AI Visibility. Click Load Posts, then Scan per post (or Scan All). Each post gets a 0–100 score with its missing pieces listed: a quotable direct-answer opening, an FAQ section, FAQ schema (structured data), scannable structure. The score also appears as a column in your posts list, so you always see GEO health at a glance.
Score Meaning 80–100 Quotable — AI answers can lift a clean answer from the post 50–79 Partial — some elements missing 0–49 Invisible to AI answers — needs work

Pro repairs a post in one click: it writes a 40–70-word direct answer at the top, appends a four-question FAQ section built from the post, and attaches FAQPage schema — then rescores. The autopilot does this on a schedule for your weakest posts, and the Citation Check actually asks an AI assistant your post's question and reports whether your site gets cited.

Pro records a daily snapshot of your site-wide GEO score and charts it on this page (with 7-day and 28-day deltas). The white-label report includes the 28-day change — proof for clients that the work moves the needle. Start with llms.txt Pair your scans with the one-click llms.txt generator so AI crawlers know what your site is about.
llms.txt is the robots.txt of the AI era — a plain-text file at your site root that tells AI crawlers what your site is, who it's for, and which pages matter most.

Go to AISiteVolt → AI Visibility and find the llms.txt card. Click Generate llms.txt. AISiteVolt composes the file from your site name, tagline and top content, writes it to your site root, and shows the live URL (https://yoursite.com/llms.txt) with a preview. If your hosting blocks writing to the site root, the preview is still shown — copy it into an llms.txt file manually via FTP or your host's file manager.
A one-paragraph description of your site and audience. Links to your cornerstone content. Anything an AI assistant should know before summarizing you.

Regenerate after major content pushes — it overwrites the file with an updated snapshot. Pair it with regular AI Visibility scans to keep both the map (llms.txt) and the territory (your posts) AI-ready.

AISiteVolt doesn't reinvent SEO plugins — it feeds them. Whenever a tool produces SEO metadata (Content Generator, Content Repair, Bulk Content, WooCommerce AI), the values are written into the fields your SEO plugin actually uses.
SEO plugin What gets written Yoast SEO Meta description, focus keyword Rank Math Meta description, focus keyword No SEO plugin Values stored in AISiteVolt's own meta so nothing is lost
SEO plugin What gets written Yoast SEO / Rank Math SEO titles too All in One SEO (AIOSEO) Description + title The SEO Framework Description + title

Generate or repair content with Generate SEO metadata enabled. AISiteVolt writes the values at save time — open the post and you'll see them already sitting in your SEO plugin's panel. Edit them there like any hand-written metadata; AISiteVolt never overwrites your later manual edits unless you run another repair that produces new SEO output. Tags and slugs too Repairs can also propose tags and a cleaner slug — you approve them in the repair review before anything is applied.
Images without alt text hurt three things at once: accessibility (screen readers announce nothing), image SEO, and AI understanding of your pages.
documents.s: Image Alt Text FREE scanner PRO writer

documents.t: Go to AISiteVolt → WooCommerce AI and find the Image alt text repair card (it scans your whole media library — not just product images). Click Scan Images: you'll see every image missing alt text, with thumbnails.

Per image — click Write alt text: the AI writes one descriptive sentence (under 125 characters, no "image of…" filler, in your site's language) using the file name, title, caption and the post it's attached to as context. Fix All — processes the whole list sequentially with a cost preview first (alt text is tiny — fractions of a cent per image). The text is saved to the image's standard WordPress alt field, so it works with every theme and plugin. Also checked elsewhere Missing alt text is one of the findings in the Accessibility scanner and the Health Report — fixing it here improves those scores too.
documents.s: Write alt text with AI PRO

documents.t: Thin product descriptions lose twice: Google ranks them lower and AI shopping answers skip them. AISiteVolt → WooCommerce AI finds the problem and (with Pro) fixes it at catalog scale.
documents.s: WooCommerce AI FREE scanner PRO writer

documents.t: Go to AISiteVolt → WooCommerce AI (requires WooCommerce active). Click Scan Products. Every product is listed with its word count and issues: description under 50 words, missing short description, missing SEO meta description. You get the exact count of products losing sales to thin content.

Per product, Pro writes in one click: a benefits-first long description (120–180 words of clean HTML), a punchy short description, a click-worthy meta description (written into your SEO plugin), product tags. The copy is grounded in real product data — SKU, price, stock status, weight, dimensions and attributes are fed to the model with the instruction to never invent specifications. Repair All queues every weak product sequentially (with a cost-estimate confirmation first) so a big catalog never times out.

Turn on the catalog autopilot and AISiteVolt keeps the catalog healthy hands-free: Enable it on the WooCommerce AI page, choose daily or weekly and products per run (1–10). Each run finds products with thin content, rewrites them, and logs the activity on the page. Healthy copy is left alone, recently repaired products are skipped for 30 days, and your monthly spend limits always apply. If the AI provider errors, the run stops rather than burn credits. tip Start with a manual Repair All to fix the backlog, then let the autopilot maintain it.
